messages:
alisa: Heads-up: small-gpu pods (~0.125) are getting scattered & then evicted in ap-northeast1 this morning. Seen ~32 evictions over 40m, mostly during burst windows.

riku: Any recent affinity label or topology changes?

alisa: No label changes. I see scheduler scoring prefers cross-rack placement when node MTU differs in a rack. Looks like we have MTU mismatch after a ToR patch.

sangeeta: MTU mismatch -> TCP segmentation + tail latency -> kubelet heartbeat p99 spikes, scheduler penalizes nodes -> placement scatter -> tiny-gang fragmentation and backfill evicts.

matt: Can you paste the scheduler trace for one pod?

alisa: snippet: 
```
I0601 06:12:02 scheduler: scoring node rack-a-03: score=85 (topology penalty:mtu-mismatch)
I0601 06:12:07 scheduler: fallback -> node rack-b-11: score=78
I0601 06:12:15 kubelet(rack-a-03): heartbeat p99=3.4s
I0601 06:12:22 eviction-controller: preempting pod small-run-003
```

opsbot: Alert: tiny-gpu-evict-spike ap-northeast1. Incident INC-5588 created.

riku: Short-term mitigation ideas?

matt: 1) Set MTU-consistency hint in scheduler for tiny-pods: prefer nodes with matching MTU to pod's node affinity. 2) Canary adjust backfill aggressiveness for pods <0.25 GPU in ap-northeast1. 3) Warm a small homogeneous pool (same MTU) to absorb tiny pods during rolling ToR work.

sangeeta: +1. Also add a taint-stabilizer so nodes toggling MTU/health don't flip scheduling preference immediately. Maybe 30s window.

alisa: I'll spin a 40-node canary warm-pool in ap-northeast1c with the same MTU as current healthy racks and apply a scheduler hint: 
```
{ "tinyPodPreferMtuMatch": "true", "backfillTinyWeight": "0.35", "taintStabilization": "30s" }
```

matt: Can we canary that on a single AZ and wire a Grafana panel for "tiny-pod fragmentation ratio by rack" + node-heartbeat p99 so we can roll back in 20m?

riku: I'll add the panels and an alert if fragmentation ratio > 6% for 10m.

opsbot: Deploy job started: scheduler-hint-canary -> ap-northeast1c (job-7026).

sangeeta: If canary works, follow-up: coordinate with network to fix MTU mismatch, and update scheduler scoring to penalize cross-MTU packing for tiny pods by default. Also evaluate cost impact of warm pools vs. increased evictions.

alisa: Canary applied, monitoring dashboards live. Will post 15m and 30m results. :eyes: :thumbsup:
